title: Mercari India - Senior Software Engineer - Backend Technologies
description:
About Us

Mercari is Japan's biggest C2C marketplace founded in 2013 with the mission to "create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy & sell".

From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018 we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission.

Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology.

Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U.S.

We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, which is a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit.

Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management.

For our services to be utilized by people worldwide; however, there is still a mountain of work ahead of us.

This endeavor naturally requires the capability of the best talent and minds, and that is exactly the reason for us to launch the India Center of Excellence.

With your help, we will continue to take on the world stage and strive to grow into a successful global tech company.

Our Culture

To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organization and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives.

Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values :

- Go Bold.
- All for One.
- Be a Pro.
- Move Fast.

Our Organization Is Also Shaped By Our Four Foundations

- Sustainability.
- Diversity & Inclusion.
- Trust & Openness.
- Well-being for Performance.

Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organization.

We invite you to read the "Mercari Culture Doc," which summarizes the behaviors and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees.

We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognized, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari's culture.

Work Responsibilities

- Design, development, and operation of APIs using Go, Java or PHP.
- Improving services and measuring effectiveness using quantitative and qualitative analysis on user behavior logs, etc.
- Design architecture and select middleware based on application requirements.
- Microservice performance tuning, monitoring, and alert handling.
- Working with PMs on a series of development tasks (plan, design, implementation, QA, release, etc.).
- Investigating inquiries from customer support or other development teams.
- Conducting system operation tasks, including responding to alerts while on call.

Bold Challenges

We are looking for people that are interested in our services, mission, and values, and want to work where engineers can go bold, use the latest technology, make autonomous decisions, and take on challenges at a rapid pace.

Minimum Requirements

- 9+ years of experience in backend design, development, and operation of APIs using Go, PHP, or Java.
- Experience developing and operating systems for large-scale products, selecting technologies, and improving their codebase.
- Experience in designing and developing databases (MySQL or similar RDBMS).
- Ability to design and develop products while considering performance and scalability.
- Experience selecting middleware and designing software architecture.
- Ability to take ownership and lead the software development process.
- Good communication skills to collaborate with stakeholders and teammates on product development.

Preferred Requirements

- Project management and/or team leadership.
- Experience developing and operating systems using microservice architecture.
- Cloud development experience (preferably GCP or AWS).
- Knowledge of and experience with databases (RDBMS/NoSQL), networks, Linux, monitoring systems, logging, and SLO/SLA.
- Experience contributing to an open-source project.

Benefits

- Employment Status: Full-time.
- Office Location: Bengaluru.
- Hybrid Workstyle: 2 days Work From Office.

We believe in high performance and professionalism.

We work from office for 2 days/week and work from home 3 days/week.

To build a strong & highly-engaged organization in India, we highly encourage everyone to work from our Bangalore office, especially during the initial office setup phase.

We will continue to review and update the policy to address future organizational needs.

Media

Owned Media :

- Mercari Engineering Portal.
- Mercan Introduces the people that make Mercari.
- Mercari US Blog.

Related Articles

- Development Platforms and Platformers: On Rising to the Global Standard Ken Wakasa, Mercari CTO | mercan.
- "I'm Not a Talented Engineer" Insists the Member-Turned-Manager Revamping Our Internal CS Tool | mercan.
- Personalize to globalize: How Mercari is reshaping their app, their company, and the world | mercan.
- The Providers of the Safe and Secure Mercari Experience: The TnS Team, Introduced by Its Members! | mercan.

title: Software Engineer I
description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?



About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Software Engineer to be part of the Data Fabric platform team —a next-generation distributed data infrastructure that enables seamless data integration, processing, governance and security at scale. As a developer, you will build robust, scalable, and high-performance systems.

What you'll do at UiPath

We are looking for talented and driven Software Engineer I who excel in creating exceptional user experiences and take pride in delivering highly scalable and maintainable solutions. While frontend expertise is a must, full-stack experience is highly preferred (but not mandatory). At UiPath, we are tackling exciting challenges, including those at the intersection of AI and intelligent agents, so if you're eager to be part of the forefront of innovation, we’d love to hear from you!


 - Passion for Building Scalable Solutions: Demonstrated ability to produce robust, well-tested, high-quality code while adhering to best practices in software development.

 - Customer-Centric Mindset: Proactively focus on enhancing customer experience and delivering impactful solutions. Strong accountability and ownership over the work you produce and the problems you solve.

 - Drive towards AI Innovation: Passionate about contributing to cutting-edge solutions involving AI-driven systems and intelligent agents, helping redefine automation and user interfaces.

 - Innovative Thinking: Stay ahead of the curve with emerging trends, especially in AI and intelligent agent technologies, and leverage them to create exceptional product experiences.

 - Team Collaboration: Work well in agile teams, contribute towards team alignment, and foster a collaborative environment where ideas and knowledge are freely exchanged.

 - Bias for Action & Adaptability: Exhibit a proactive, can-do attitude with an entrepreneurial mindset. Comfortable navigating dynamic environments and embracing ambiguity when solving complex business problems.

 - Effective Communication Skills: Clearly articulate technical ideas, design decisions, and solutions to diverse audiences in both written and verbal formats while driving consensus.
   
   
   
   What you'll bring to the team

 - 1–2 years of hands-on experience as a software developer (internships and project work count).

 - Strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar.
   Experience using AI models or APIs to build real software — not just academic or research exposure.

 - Comfortable working with APIs, backend services, and cloud infrastructure.
   A builder’s mindset: you like creating usable things, fast.

 - Curiosity about how AI is reshaping software development and user experiences.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy https://www.uipath.com/legal/trust-and-security/privacy-policy.

title: Applied AI Engineer (AWS) - Lead Software Engineer I
description:
Summary

 Position Summary 

 Lead Applied AI Full Stack Engineer I 

 Role Overview: As a Lead Applied AI Engineer I , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to building and enhancing high-visibility, full-stack products that serve the business and its users. Your expertise will be pivotal in delighting customers and users, while driving tangible value across Deloitte’s product and AI investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship and advanced proficiency across full-stack software engineering and modern frameworks—together with applied AI fluency that lets you build GenAI and agentic capabilities directly into the products you deliver—consistently demonstrating your exemplary track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a role-model leader and mentor, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and ship products end to end, from concept through production.

 Key Responsibilities: 

- Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes—and for the cost of achieving them. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations, and owning the inference, token, and cloud cost of what you build. 
- Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, low-level architecture and component design, development, testing, integrations, and support. 
- Maintain accountability for the integrity of architecture and technical stack to the enterprise standards and strategy. Manage dependencies, code design, implementation, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code and review code of other engineers, mentoring them, to ensure all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams. 
- Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time. 
- Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions. 
- Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation. 
- Possess deep expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from discovery to production to operations with all quality checks through SSDLC lifecycle. Be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning. 
- Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and UX/UI designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff. 
- Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives. 
- Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions. 

 The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

 The successful candidate will possess: 

- Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

 Required Qualifications: 

- A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.
- 6+ years of full-stack software engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python, C#, .NET, Java, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, as well as unit and integration testing frameworks.
- 3+ years of experience building AI/ML and agentic applications, with hands-on GenAI experience across LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models), RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector databases, evaluations, and AI agent orchestration.
- 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering, using FaaS, PaaS, or micro-services on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI, plus application-level infrastructure-as-code and cost-aware engineering (FinOps accountability).
- 1+ years of experience in establishing engineering standards, including actively leading, mentoring, and guiding team members in the adoption and continuous improvement of these standards.
- Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development.

title: Staff Software Engineer (Bangalore, India)
description:
About AiPrise

AiPrise is a global compliance orchestration platform helping fintechs, marketplaces, and payment companies verify and onboard customers worldwide. We integrate with 80+ identity and compliance vendors to deliver a holistic view of risk. We're now building AI-powered compliance agents to revolutionize KYB, AML, sanctions screening, and risk scoring — enabling our customers to onboard faster, reduce manual reviews, and prevent financial crime.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer in Bangalore to set the technical direction for the core platform behind AiPrise's compliance orchestration and AI agent systems.

This is our most senior individual-contributor role. You will own the architecture of a major part of the platform, lead the hardest multi-quarter technical initiatives across teams, and raise the engineering bar for a team that is growing fast. You'll work directly with the head of engineering, engineering managers, product managers, FDEs, etc. to turn customer and regulatory needs into technical strategy, and then ship it.

We process verification requests for financial institutions in a regulated environment, so reliability, security, and data integrity are not afterthoughts. If you want a role where your judgment shapes how the platform scales for the next several years, and where you still write code, this is it.

What You'll Do

Set technical direction

- Own the architecture and multi-quarter technical roadmap for a core area of the platform: vendor orchestration, case management, platform, or the AI agents 
- Lead our largest and most ambiguous technical initiatives end to end: framing the problem, design, sequencing across teams, delivery, and rollout or migration 
- Author and review RFCs, run design reviews, and make the hard calls on build vs. buy, consistency vs. speed, and when to pay down debt 
- Set the standard for reliability, security, and data integrity in a regulated environment: SLOs, incident response, change management, and audit-readiness 

Scale the platform

- Evolve the orchestration layer to handle 10x verification volume across 80+ vendors: throughput, latency, failover, and cost 
- Shape the developer platform (service boundaries, shared libraries, CI/CD, observability) so a fast-growing team can ship safely and often 
- Take our AI agent systems from promising to production-grade: evaluation, guardrails, human-in-the-loop workflows, and the data pipelines behind them 
- Stay hands-on: prototype the risky parts, unblock critical paths, and ship code that others build on 

Multiply the team

- Act as technical lead and mentor to senior engineers; grow the next generation of tech leads 
- Partner with the founders, engineering managers, product, and compliance experts on the roadmap; translate customer and regulatory needs into technical strategy 
- Represent engineering with enterprise customers on architecture, security reviews, and integration design 
- Help us hire: design interviews, calibrate the bar, and close senior candidates 

What We're Looking For

Must-have

- 9+ years building and operating production systems, with at least 2 years at Staff-level scope: setting technical direction for multiple teams or a major system 
- A track record of leading cross-team technical initiatives from an ambiguous problem to a shipped, adopted result 
- Deep expertise in distributed systems and backend architecture: service design, data modeling, API design, event-driven systems, consistency trade-offs, and failure modes 
- You have designed, scaled, and operated high-throughput, high-reliability systems, and carried the pager for them 
- Strong in at least one of Python, Go, or TypeScript/Node.js; comfortable working across the stack when the problem calls for it 
- Writing that changes decisions: RFCs, design docs, and postmortems that a team can act on 
- Experience mentoring senior engineers and measurably raising an organization's engineering standards 
- Judgment about when to be pragmatic and when to insist, and the credibility to carry either call with founders and peers 

Nice-to-have

- Experience in FinTech, RegTech, payments, identity verification, or fraud/risk detection, and working knowledge of KYC/KYB, AML, and sanctions screening 
- Built or operated a platform that integrates dozens of third-party vendors: response normalization, failover, rate limits, and vendor observability 
- Shipped production LLM or ML systems: evaluation, guardrails, cost and latency management, document intelligence 
- Security and compliance engineering: SOC 2 or ISO 27001, data residency, encryption, audit trails 
- Helped an engineering team grow several-fold while keeping quality and velocity up 
- Frontend experience (React, TypeScript) for internal tools and case management UI 

Success in This Role Looks Like

- In 1 month: You understand the platform end to end, have shipped a meaningful improvement to a critical path, and have published an RFC with a clear point of view on our highest-leverage technical problem. You've taken on technical leadership of a core area. 
- In 3 months: You're leading a cross-team initiative with a defined roadmap and visible progress. Design reviews and RFCs are a working habit across the team, not a ritual. At least one reliability or velocity metric has moved because of your work. 
- In 3 months: The architecture for the platform's next phase is defined and delivered. Senior engineers you've mentored are leading their own initiatives. The founders and engineering managers treat you as the technical counterpart for the hardest calls. 

Why AiPrise

- Direct impact: Your decisions shape infrastructure that processes millions of verifications and fights financial crime for leading financial institutions 
- Hard problems: Compliance, AI, fraud detection, and distributed systems, across data from 200+ countries and 80+ vendors 
- Real ownership: Set technical direction for the platform at the stage where it matters most 
- Fast loop: Your code reaches production in days, not months 
- The team: Work in person with a mission-driven team in Bangalore, alongside the founders 
- Compensation: Competitive salary, meaningful equity, and comprehensive benefits 

About The Interview

- Remote: Exploratory DSA Round 
- In-office 
- Remote: Behavioural (Head of Engineering) 
- Remote: Compensation Discussion

Angel Lane Partners (ALP) is a computational finance, data engineering and AI/ML firm with offices in Dubai, London, Bengaluru and Riyadh. We work with banks, financial institutions and government entities across the GCC.

Role Overview
You will build the web applications in the analytics and calculation platforms ALP delivers to financial-services clients. You will work end to end, from Python APIs and relational data models to React front ends where users enter data, run calculations, manage approvals and review results. You will work with data engineers, quant developers and analysts, and deliver production software for regulated clients.

Travel
The role is based in Bengaluru, with frequent travel to client sites in the GCC, sometimes for several weeks at a time. A valid passport is required.

Key Responsibilities
• Build end-to-end features using Python (Flask or FastAPI), relational databases and React.

• Build front-end workflows: multi-period data-entry grids, multi-tab forms, editable tables with computed columns, client-side validation and results dashboards.
• Build reusable React components and handle state management, API integration, caching, loading states and error handling.
• Develop server-side workflows for maker-checker approvals, versioned parameters and reference data, configuration management and audit logging.

• Design and maintain database schemas, migrations, indexes and constraints; implement background and long-running tasks (Celery, RQ or equivalent).
• Write unit, integration, API and end-to-end tests; improve front-end rendering, API response times and query performance.
• Implement logging, monitoring, error tracking and health checks; support deployments, CI/CD, environment configuration and production troubleshooting on AWS and on client infrastructure.
• Take part in architecture and code reviews, release planning and documentation.

Required Skills
• 4–6 years building production full-stack web applications.
• Python with Flask, FastAPI or Django; REST/HTTP/JSON, authentication, authorisation and API versioning.
• React with TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML and CSS; hooks and reusable components.
• At least one state-management approach (Redux, Zustand, Context or React Query) and one build tool (Vite, Webpack or Next.js).

• SQL and relational modelling; hands-on PostgreSQL or Microsoft SQL Server, including migrations, indexing, query optimisation, transactions and concurrency.

• Automated testing: pytest, Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright or Cypress.
• Git (branching, pull requests, code reviews) and CI/CD with environment-based configuration.
• Hands-on AWS experience deploying and running applications, such as EC2, ECS, RDS or S3.
• Secure coding: OWASP risks, input sanitisation and secrets management.

Preferred Skills
• Banking or financial-services applications (pricing, risk, regulatory reporting, reconciliation) where accuracy and reproducibility are critical.
• Maker-checker workflows, approval hierarchies, audit trails and effective-dated configuration.
• Enterprise identity providers, JWT, row-level security and business-unit data segregation.
• Redis, caching and message queues for asynchronous or scheduled jobs.
• Template-driven Excel and report generation.

• Certifications in BI, ML, cloud or infrastructure.
• Observability tools such as Sentry, Prometheus, Grafana or OpenTelemetry.

Qualifications

• At least one full-stack application taken from design through to production deployment; regulated or data-sensitive environments preferred.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Agentops
description:
Job Title: Staff Software Engineer

Job Description: Are you the engineer who sets where an agentic platform is going, proves the next wave of technology by building it, and lifts every engineer around you—while still shipping the hardest parts yourself? This role exists to do three things at once: architect the platform’s future state, bring cutting-edge and market-trending technology into Pearson through POCs and MVPs, and mentor the engineers who build alongside you.

Join our AgentOps Engineering team and shape the platform that powers agent crews running across the business. It’s a hands-on Staff-level role balanced across building, technical leadership, and proving new technology. You’ll define where orchestration, runtime, skills, and evaluation are heading—and prove your decisions with reference implementations and working prototypes, not just diagrams. Through this, you’ll help teams across Pearson put dependable AI agents to work, and help people realize the lives they imagine through learning.

This role aligns to industry job titles such as Agentops Engineer, Staff Engineer- Agentic Systems

Work Location/s: Bengaluru, India

Set the technical direction for Agentic AI at Pearson as part of the AgentOps Engineering team. Inspire innovation. Empower learning.

Pearson, the world’s leading learning company, is hiring a Staff Engineer to architect the future of our AgentOps Engineering platform, prove out emerging technology, and grow the engineers around them—while staying hands-on in the code.

Why This Role Matters

As a senior technical leader on the AgentOps Engineering team and at Pearson, you will be expected to embody, and role model our leadership dimensions:

- Live Our Purpose: You connect technical direction to Pearson’s mission and strategy, and help others see the same line.

- Simplify the Complexity: You set direction in a fast-changing field, distilling complex agentic systems into clear, reliable architecture others can build on.

- Carry Our Culture: You lead through design and code reviews, mentor engineers, and raise the bar without authority—building an inclusive, high-performing team.

- Deliver Results: You set the quality bar, own the hardest technical outcomes, and ship the patterns the platform depends on.

What You’ll Do

- Architect the future state

- Own where the platform is going—define the target-state architecture for orchestration, runtime, skills and tools, and evaluation, and the roadmap of patterns and standards that gets there.

- Make and document the hard trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, resilience, and maintainability; prove your decisions with reference implementations, not just diagrams.

- Scout and prove emerging technology

- Track the fast-moving agentic-AI landscape—new frameworks, models, protocols, and techniques—and judge what’s worth Pearson’s investment.

- De-risk the promising bets by building them: rapid POCs and MVPs that prove value, expose limits, and create a clear path from prototype to production.

- Design and build the platform

- Design multi-agent and digital-worker orchestration patterns—delegation, cyclic and stateful workflows, reflection, recovery, and adaptive execution—and build the hardest pieces yourself.

- Define how routing works across the platform—intent classification, capability-based dispatch, fallback, escalation—and the reusable components behind it.

- Design long-running, resumable workflows (checkpointing, persistence, context restoration) and resilience patterns for non-deterministic AI; set the standards for safe agent write actions—idempotency, human-in-the-loop gates, structured outputs, audit-ready logging.

- Define skills, tools, and evaluation

- Establish how skills and tools are built, exposed, discovered, versioned, and consumed, and drive tool/context interoperability standards across the platform.

- Define how the platform evaluates agents—task success, groundedness, tool-use accuracy, schema conformance, regression against golden fixtures—and instrument deep tracing and observability.

- Mentor and raise the bar

- Grow IC20–IC25 engineers through design and code reviews, pairing, and hands-on guidance; this is a core reason the role exists, not a side duty.

- Multiply the team’s output through reusable patterns, shared libraries, and the prompts and workflows you put into everyone’s hands; make AI-pair-programming a high-leverage, high-quality default.

Who You Are

- A Staff-level engineer who sets technical direction and writes the hardest code—architecture without hands-on depth isn’t this role.

- A forward-looking architect who can see where the platform should go and prove the path with working prototypes.

- A mentor who grows other engineers and lifts the whole team’s bar—through influence, not authority.

- Someone with deep trade-off judgment across quality, latency, cost, resilience, and maintainability.

What You’ll Bring

(we hire for demonstrated skill, not years on a résumé)

- You’ve designed and built production-grade agentic systems—architecture you proved by shipping it.

- You scout emerging technology and de-risk it through rapid POCs and MVPs that lead somewhere real.

- Deep Python and backend/platform engineering—async services, typed code, and clean, scalable architecture.

- You set patterns and standards others adopt: orchestration, agent tooling, runtime, and resilience for non-deterministic AI.

- You design and build agent orchestration and routing across frameworks—delegation, retries, fallback, structured outputs, human-in-the-loop.

- You own a real platform codebase end-to-end—APIs, runtime, storage—and raise its engineering bar.

- Strong prompt engineering for structured outputs, nested schemas, and multi-agent coordination.

- You mentor engineers and lead through design and code reviews, without managing them.

Even Better…

- Experience defining evaluation strategy for agentic systems—groundedness, tool-use accuracy, regression suites.

- Experience with tool/context interoperability protocols (such as MCP).

- Deep experience with a major cloud platform (AWS preferred), containerization, CI/CD, and state stores for orchestration and persistence.

- AI observability and evaluation tooling for LLM systems.

- RAG and memory patterns: vector databases, hybrid retrieval, re-ranking, and grounding.

- Secure execution, sandboxing, and prompt-injection mitigation.

What You’ll Gain

- A front-row seat setting the technical direction of enterprise agentic AI infrastructure teams across Pearson rely on.

- A mandate to explore the frontier of agentic AI and bring the best of it into production.

- Real ownership of the architecture, standards, and patterns that define the platform.

- A collaborative, inclusive, and innovation-driven culture, with access to cutting-edge tools and thought leadership.

Why Pearson?

At Pearson, we don’t just build careers—we accelerate them. Known for our strong culture of internal mobility and leadership development, we offer a clear path to broader technical leadership.

We believe great work deserves great rewards. That’s why we offer some of the most competitive benefits in the industry—designed to support the diverse needs of our people and their families. Explore our Benefits.

At Pearson, we’re reimagining learning through technology. If you set the technical bar, build with craft, and want to shape how an enterprise puts AI agents to work at scale—we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and imagine the impact you can make.

Who we are:

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

description:
Our Story

At The Alter Office, we build what comes next. We operate as an internal innovation lab, creating stealth products, new business bets, and high-leverage systems designed to unlock disproportionate value for us and our partner company ITW Consulting.

Our work is not centered around being a conventional service partner. Instead, we focus on building products and platforms that solve complex, strategic problems and create long-term advantage. Where needed, we have stepped in on critical opportunities beyond the usual scope, especially when speed, product thinking, and execution depth mattered most.

About The Role

We are building a holistic AdTech platform that delivers premium value to both advertisers and publishers, and the backend is where that entire ecosystem actually runs - the ad marketplace, campaign creation, ad-serving decisioning, analytics collection, attribution, and ROAS measurement.

Concretely, that means large-scale architecture: the ad-serving systems that make real-time decisioning calls at volume, the scalable data platforms that ingest and process billions of events a day, the analytics platforms that turn that data into attribution and ROAS numbers advertisers and publishers trust, and the autonomous AI agents we're building to automate campaign optimization and decisioning across the platform.

We are looking for someone who is eager to learn, enjoys solving technical problems, and wants to grow beyond simply implementing tasks. You'll have opportunities to understand how backend systems connect to the product and gradually take ownership of larger parts of the platform.

Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain backend APIs and services for our ad marketplace, campaign management, and analytics platforms.
- Work with senior engineers to design and implement scalable backend solutions.
- Develop RESTful APIs and asynchronous backend workflows.
- Work with SQL databases such as MySQL and PostgreSQL and NoSQL technologies such as MongoDB and Redis.
- Implement data models, database queries, caching, and basic performance optimizations.
- Contribute to backend infrastructure supporting analytics, attribution, and AI-powered platform features.
- Collaborate with product, frontend, backend, and DevOps teams to deliver end-to-end features.
- Implement authentication, authorization, and basic security practices under the guidance of senior engineers.
- Write clean, maintainable, documented, and tested code.
- Use Git and participate in code reviews and team development practices.
- Learn and contribute to deploying backend services on cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
- Work with Docker for containerizing backend services.
- Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and development workflows.
- Help monitor, debug, and troubleshoot backend services in development and production environments.
- Explore event-driven and distributed architectures using technologies such as message brokers, WebSockets, or GraphQL where appropriate.

Requirements

- 1–2 years of professional backend engineering experience, including relevant internship or project experience.
- Proficiency in at least one backend language, with the ability and willingness to adapt to other languages such as Node.js/JavaScript, Go, Python, and Java.
- Good understanding of RESTful API design and backend fundamentals.
- Good understanding of asynchronous programming and how backend services communicate.
- Familiarity with relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.
- Familiarity with at least one NoSQL database such as MongoDB or Redis is a plus.
- Good understanding of data modeling and writing SQL queries.
- Familiarity with Git and software development workflows.
- Good understanding of Docker and containerized applications.
- Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure is a plus.
- Understanding of basic backend security concepts such as authentication, authorization, and secure API practices.
- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
- Good communication and willingness to collaborate with other engineers and product teams.
- Strong learning mindset and willingness to work with unfamiliar technologies.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.

5 steps, and we tell you where you stand at each one.

Online Assessment : Evaluate coding skills, backend fundamentals, SQL, problem-solving, and technical understanding.

Technical Interview 1 : Discuss previous projects, backend experience, APIs, databases, system design, and production experience.

Take-Home Assessment : A practical backend assignment to evaluate code quality, architecture, scalability, testing, and ability to build a production-ready solution.

Technical Interview 2 : Deep dive into the take-home assignment, system design, technical decisions, scalability, debugging, cloud, and architecture.

HR Interview : Discuss communication, ownership, culture fit, career goals, compensation, availability, and overall expectations.

Skills:- Architecture, WebSocket, Authentication, Redis, RESTful APIs, cicd, Debugging, Ruby, Amazon Web Services (AWS), SQL, GraphQL, grafana, Docker, Python, Java, Kubernetes, prometheus, NOSQL Databases, Microsoft Windows Azure, RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL, Microservices, MySQL, Authorization, Data security, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and MongoDB

title: Software Engineer - AI Accelerated Development
description:
About Signant Health

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

About The Role

Signant Health is looking for a Software Engineer – AI Accelerated Development to build AI-powered, agentic features into our clinical trial platforms. Working across the .NET stack, you will take AI capabilities from backend LLM integration through to a usable front-end — designing agents and agentic workflows, not just prompting a model. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who works with agentic tooling every day and wants to ship production AI in a regulated, high-impact environment. We weigh the depth of your AI and agentic build experience more heavily than years of general experience: a developer with one to three years of substantive, hands-on agentic work is exactly the profile we are targeting.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES – Function

- 1-4 Years of experience in AI, .NET and Fullstack.
- Design and build AI agents and agentic workflows — tool-use/function calling, multi-step task orchestration, and agent loops — that power Signant Health's clinical trial platforms.
- Integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI) into .NET application code, handling authentication, streaming, error handling, and cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Deliver AI features end-to-end, taking them from backend integration through to a usable, production-ready front-end.
- Build custom agents and tools with the Claude Agent SDK, wiring and steering agent loops.
- Author custom skills and slash commands for Claude Code to codify team-specific workflows.
- Implement RAG pipelines and integrate vector stores (e.g. Qdrant, pgvector, Pinecone) to ground agent outputs in trusted data.
- Instrument agents for evaluation and observability so their outputs can be verified, measured, and audited.
- Apply AI-specific risk controls appropriate to a regulated clinical environment, addressing hallucination, determinism, and auditability of agent decisions.
- Use Claude Code (or an equivalent agentic CLI) daily as a primary development tool, reviewing and steering AI-generated diffs. 
- 
Knowledge, Skills & Attributes

Essential:

- Full-stack .NET development — C#/ASP.NET Core on the backend paired with a modern front-end framework.
- Hands-on agentic development experience — building AI agents or agentic workflows (tool-use/function calling, multi-step task orchestration, agent loops); not just prompting an LLM, but building systems around one.
- Practical LLM API integration (Anthropic, OpenAI, Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI), including authentication, streaming, error handling, and cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Proven full-stack delivery of AI features — able to take an agentic/AI feature from backend integration through to a usable front-end, not just a notebook prototype.
- Daily, hands-on use of Claude Code (or an equivalent agentic CLI) as a primary development tool — comfortable working through multi-step agentic sessions and reviewing and steering AI-generated diffs, rather than occasional autocomplete-style use.
- Prompt engineering — designing and iterating on system prompts as production software contracts, not one-off experiments.
- Python proficiency as the preferred language for AI/agent tooling; comfort with async patterns a plus.
- Evaluation and observability literacy — able to reason about whether an agent's output is correct and instrument it to prove so. 
- 
Desirable:

- Claude Agent SDK experience — building custom agents, defining tools, and wiring agent loops.
- Working knowledge of agent primitives: hooks (deterministic pre/post-tool-call controls), skills (progressive-disclosure, load-on-demand instructions), subagents/multi-agent delegation, and session/state management.
- Experience authoring custom skills or slash commands for Claude Code to codify team-specific workflows.
- Exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) for connecting agents to internal tools and data sources.
- Working knowledge of RAG patterns and vector store integration (e.g. Qdrant, pgvector, Pinecone).
- Awareness of AI-specific risk areas relevant to a regulated environment (OWASP LLM Top 10, hallucination/determinism concerns, and auditability of agent decisions). 
- 
Why Signant Health?

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. You make decisions and are comfortable with ambiguity. You're equally credible writing code, reviewing a pull request or presenting to senior stakeholders. You set the technical bar by example.

Application Software Development:

title: SENIOR, SOFTWARE ENGINEER
description:
Skillset: Java, Spring boot, Microservices, Distributed Systems, DS/Algo, System Design

About Team

GDF (Global Data Foundation) is part of Walmart's AI & Data organization - the team building the foundational data platforms that power AI, analytics, and decision-making across every Walmart banner and geography, from supply chain and merchandising to customer experience and enterprise AI agents. Our newly created platform team is chartered with building next-generation data infrastructure at Walmart scale: reliable, high-throughput data pipelines, distributed processing systems, and platform capabilities that downstream teams across Walmart depend on every day.

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate distributed platform services and APIs using Java and Python, applied against Kubernetes or equivalent cloud-native infrastructure.
- Apply system design and low-level design (LLD) rigor to platform problems - evaluating dependencies, trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, and cost before writing a line of code, with support from Staff/Principal engineers on the most ambiguous or cross-team problems.
- Flex into data engineering work when needed: contribute to Spark-based data pipelines and processing jobs, working directly in GDF's data engineering codebase alongside platform work.
- Build AI, GenAI, and agentic-powered platform capabilities: intelligent developer tooling, workflow automation, agentic services, and AI-assisted operational tooling (monitoring, incident triage, capacity planning).
- Own reliability, scalability, and observability for the services you build - service-level objectives, distributed tracing, alerting, and incident response - with a strong Operational Excellence / Engineering Excellence discipline.
- Contribute to architecture and system design decisions across microservices, event-driven systems, and enterprise integrations, with an eye toward how platform choices affect downstream data engineering workloads.
- Partner with data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers to ensure the services you own expose the right primitives for data pipelines, feature stores, and model-serving paths.
- Participate actively in architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and production readiness reviews for a team building process from scratch.
- As a Senior engineer, bring strong technical judgment to design and code reviews within your immediate team and area of ownership, mentor early-career engineers, and help raise the bar for engineering quality - without needing a formal management title.
- Stay current on emerging platform, cloud, and AI/agentic technologies, and propose where they could pragmatically improve reliability, productivity, or business value within your team's scope.

What You'll Bring

- Genuinely hands-on coding: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating distributed platforms; strong proficiency in Java and Python is required - comfortable writing, reviewing, and debugging production code. Additional experience with Go, C++, or Scala is a plus.
- Operational Excellence (OE) and Engineering Excellence (EE) mindset is a required skill, not a nice-to-have: SLO/SLA ownership, incident management and blameless post-incident reviews, proactive reliability and quality metrics, and continuous improvement built into how you ship, not bolted on afterward.
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
- Solid experience with microservices architectures, distributed systems, event-driven patterns, API design, service contracts, and enterprise system integration - backed by solid system design and low-level design (LLD) skills, with demonstrated ownership of production code and the judgment to evaluate trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, and cost for the components you own.
- Solid understanding of cloud-native engineering practices - CI/CD, containerization, Kubernetes or equivalent orchestration, infrastructure automation, and production operations.
- Working exposure to Big Data / data engineering technologies - Spark required at a working level, with familiarity in Hadoop/HDFS, Hive, or Kafka - enough to flex into data engineering work confidently.
- Full exposure to AI and Agentic technologies: hands-on experience integrating model APIs and GenAI/LLM tooling, building or operating agentic workflows (tool-calling agents, multi-step autonomous systems), working with embeddings/vector search, and applying MLOps practices (feature stores, model lifecycle, retraining pipelines) - not just conceptual awareness.
- Solid knowledge of reliability engineering - observability, distributed tracing, logging, metrics, alerting, incident response, capacity planning, and fault tolerance for large-scale systems.
- Solid grounding in security, privacy, and enterprise engineering practices, including authentication, authorization, data protection, and secure API design.
- Proven ability to translate reasonably well-scoped technical/business problems into clear execution plans, particularly within a newly formed team - escalating cross-team ambiguity to Staff/Principal engineers as needed.
- Strong ownership mindset and technical judgment; comfortable operating with autonomy within your team in a 0-to-1 environment.

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. title: Software Development Engineer, AWS DynamoDB
description:
Description

AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Do you want to work on a product that can do the following?:

Access petabytes of data in single-digit milliseconds

Replicate tables across continents

Stream terabytes of data updates per hour continuously

Back up hundreds of terabytes of data in seconds

Encrypt petabytes of data with no performance degradation

Amazon DynamoDB is a NoSQL database service that does all this and more. DynamoDB is a key-value and document database that delivers single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale. DynamoDB can store petabytes of customer data and handle peaks of more than 20 million requests per second.

As a fast growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses, such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises, such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One, depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission-critical workloads.

DynamoDB is one of the largest distributed database systems in the world, and we continue to believe it is Day 1 for the DynamoDB business. We are constantly improving and adding new capabilities to DynamoDB, and we are looking for a deeply technical, team-first software development engineer to push DynamoDB even further.

DynamoDB engineers are constantly challenged to think of unique and innovative solutions. The quality bar is high. As an engineer here, you will work on the hardest engineering problems in distributed systems at a massive scale and on multiple dimensions. You will exercise your intellectual curiosity, work with motivated teams of sharp individuals, and get insightful guidance from senior and principal engineers.

This is a hands-on position in which you will own everything from end to end: requirements gathering, designs, design reviews, implementations, code reviews, incremental feature launches, operations, mentoring, and the driving of continuous improvement.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Member of Technical Staff, AI Engineering (India)
description:
About Handshake

Handshake's mission is to organize expert human knowledge to advance the AI economy. Handshake AI works directly with frontier labs on their most consequential data, evaluation, and post-training challenges, building the systems that turn expert human knowledge into the data and evaluations that make frontier models better.

You will work alongside engineers, researchers, operators, and builders from organizations including Scale AI, Meta, Google, Amazon, xAI, Notion, and Palantir—and help build the systems that make expert human knowledge useful for advancing AI.

About Handshake Labs

Handshake Labs is building external AI products, research platforms, and customer-facing AI systems. We are evolving work that is often custom-built for an individual partner into reusable products and platforms that improve with every deployment.

Our work spans the full post-training loop: designing evaluations and training environments, building high-quality data and feedback systems, running experiments, and turning what works into durable infrastructure. For example, we are developing agents that can analyze long, complex coding-agent sessions in days rather than weeks—with expert review and calibration built into the system.

The Role

We are hiring a Member of Technical Staff to help build the data systems that make frontier model training possible. The data Handshake builds for and acquires on behalf of labs is getting more complex and more sensitive, and this role is responsible for improving how we generate, process, and prepare that data—whether that means building higher-quality synthetic and LLM-generated training data, or making acquired third-party data safe to use by removing personal information while preserving the structure that makes it valuable.

You will partner with researchers, domain experts, legal/compliance stakeholders, and customers to turn ambiguous data questions—about generation, quality, evaluation, or privacy—into experiments, pipelines, and durable products. Early members of the team will have unusual influence over our technical direction, standards, and culture.

Location: Bangalore

What You’ll Do

- Design and build systems that improve the quality, scale, and safety of the data Handshake generates and acquires for frontier model training—spanning synthetic data generation and data anonymization/PII removal.
- Translate ambiguous research, partner, or compliance needs into clear hypotheses, experiments, evaluation plans, and production-quality implementations.
- Build and improve data-processing pipelines, evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and quality-control systems, whether the goal is generating higher-signal synthetic data or verifying that sensitive data has been properly de-identified.
- Run fast, rigorous iteration loops: prototype, evaluate, interpret results, and turn learnings into the next system or product.
- Partner directly with researchers, domain experts, and—where relevant—legal and compliance teams to ensure data is both high-utility and responsibly handled.
- Identify repeatable patterns across engagements and productize them into reusable software and platforms.
- Raise the technical bar through strong design judgment, clear communication, code quality, and mentorship.

What We’re Looking For

- 2–10 years of recent, demonstrated experience in one or more of: synthetic/LLM-generated data, post-training and model-evaluation work, privacy engineering, or data anonymization/de-identification at scale.
- A hands-on individual contributor track record—this is not a team-lead or engineering-management role.
- Strong Python skills and the ability to write clean, efficient, scalable software for large, messy, real-world datasets.
- Sound judgment for reasoning about data quality, risk, and utility—forming hypotheses, choosing meaningful metrics, diagnosing failures, and distinguishing signal from noise.
- Experience designing systems—not only implementing specifications—including tradeoffs around quality, scale, reliability, and reuse.
- Comfort operating in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment with substantial ownership.
- Collaborative, low-ego communication and the ability to work effectively with researchers, engineers, domain experts, and customers.

Especially Compelling Experience

- Building or operating large-scale synthetic or LLM-generated data pipelines for model training.
- Building or operating large-scale data de-identification or anonymization systems, ideally involving relational or graph-structured data, with experience preserving referential/relationship integrity after anonymization.
- Developing LLM/agent benchmarks, evaluation methodologies, annotation systems, or data-quality frameworks.
- Research or applied work on reinforcement learning, alignment, model behavior, synthetic data, or human-in-the-loop systems.
- Prior work in a regulated or high-sensitivity data environment (healthcare, finance, HR/people data, government), or experience with re-identification risk assessment and privacy auditing.
- Published research, meaningful open-source contributions, or evidence of technical leadership in ML systems, data engineering, or AI research.
- Experience productizing research or repeated customer work into robust, reusable platforms.

Why join

- Work on problems at the center of how frontier AI systems improve, alongside leading labs and domain experts.
- Help build an early technical organization where your work shapes the roadmap, standards, and culture.
- Move fluidly from research insight to real-world systems, with the resources and customer context to see those systems matter.
- Join a company building durable infrastructure for careers in the AI economy.

Perks

- Generous Equity Grant vested over 4 years
- Housing Bonus: 1.3 Lakhs spread throughout the first year
- Well Defined Performance Bonus ranging between 10 - 100% of base
- Medical Insurance Coverage
- Food credit for every in person day.

title: Senior System Software Engineer - GPU
description:
NVIDIA is seeking an outstanding Senior System Software Engineer to join our Display Driver team. You will develop production-quality system software for next-generation NVIDIA GPU and Tegra platforms, working across operating systems such as Linux and Android.
The role combines broad kernel-mode driver development with opportunities to work on display security technologies, including High-bandwidth Digital Content Protection (HDCP). You will collaborate with hardware, firmware, security, and system software teams to deliver reliable and secure display solutions.

What you’ll be doing
- Design, develop, test, and maintain GPU/display kernel-mode drivers and embedded firmware.
- Develop system software across Linux, Android or similar operating system.
- Implement and maintain HDCP and related display-content-protection functionality.
- Debug interactions across software, firmware, hardware, and external display devices.
- Develop multithreaded, performance-sensitive software in C.
- Participate in design, code, and security reviews.
- Build automated tests and diagnostic tools to improve reliability and interoperability.
- Collaborate with teams across NVIDIA and external partners throughout the product lifecycle.

What we need to see
- BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
- 5+ years of experience developing system software, embedded software, firmware, or kernel-mode drivers.
- Strong C programming and debugging skills.
- Solid understanding of operating-system fundamentals, computer architecture, memory management, synchronization, and concurrency.
- Experience developing low-level software on Linux, Android, or a similar operating system.
- Familiarity with secure protocols, cryptographic concepts, authentication, key management, or content-protection technologies.

- Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.

Ways to stand out from the crowd
- Experience implementing or debugging HDCP 1.x/2.x authentication and content-protection flows.
- Knowledge of HDMI, DisplayPort, USB-C DisplayPort Alt Mode, DDC/I²C, or DisplayPort AUX protocols.
- Experience with Linux DRM/KMS or graphics/display kernel drivers.
- Familiarity with trusted execution environments, secure firmware, hardware security modules, or secure key provisioning.
- Experience in debugging display interoperability, or content-protection certification issues.

Experience driving technology modernization initiatives, including cloud adoption, platform transformation, and modernization of legacy applications.

Demonstrated technical leadership as an individual contributor, influencing architecture decisions, driving technical strategy, and leading large cross-team initiatives.
Ability to translate business and product requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions.

Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a proven ability to work effectively across engineering, product, architecture, data science, QA, and operations teams.

Experience leading and coordinating technical initiatives across globally distributed teams spanning multiple regions and time zones.

Passion for mentoring and developing engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, and knowledge sharing.

Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work through ambiguity, make sound technical decisions, and drive results through hands-on execution.

- Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience deploying and operating AI workloads on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
- Data: Proficiency with SQL and NoSQL databases, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, ChromaDB), and data pipeline tools

- AI Tools Proficiency: Advanced daily usage of AI coding assistants with demonstrated impact on productivity and code quality
- Testing: Strong testing practices for AI systems including model evaluation, integration testing, and automated quality checks
- Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to explain complex AI concepts to diverse audiences

- Experience with agent-based AI architectures and autonomous multi-step workflows
- Knowledge of AI security concerns (prompt injection, data leakage, model poisoning) and mitigation strategies

description:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

The Global Supply Chain Technology Team enables the warehouse systems, integrations, reporting, and operational capabilities that support Converse distribution across North America and the Converse European Logistics Centerin Belgium.The team partners with Distribution Center Operations, Supply Chain and Logistics, SAP and integration teams, infrastructure providers, enterprise technology, and external solution partners to deliver reliable warehouse capabilities. The team supports Manhattan WMi (IBMi Platform), Manhattan SCI (IBM Cognos) reporting, inventory synchronization, fulfillment, shipping, returns, value-added services, warehouse automation, and connected suppy chain integrations. The team is strengthening internal support capability, operational resilience, documentation, and continuous improvement across these business-critical platforms.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The Senior Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) Engineer is a Bangalore-based, hybrid, hands-on senior individual contributor responsible for supporting, maintaining, configuring, and enhancing warehouse management capabilities across North America Distribution Centers and Converse ELC in Belgium. Working under the direction of the WMS Lead, this role provides advanced L2/L3 technical support for Manhattan WMi (IBMi Platform) and related applications. The engineer independently diagnoses production issues, implements approved configuration and reporting changes, supports integrations and deployments, and contributes technical analysis and recommendations to the Lead and broader solution teams. The role focuses on reliable execution and deep technical support. Accountability for technology strategy, solution ownership, roadmap decisions, cross-team governance, and overall delivery leadership remains with the WMS Lead or Technology Manager.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

• Provide L3 technical support for Manhattan WMi (IBMi Platform) and related supply chain applications, following established support and escalation processes.
• Troubleshoot complex incidents affecting receiving, putaway, inventory management, replenishment, wave planning, picking, packing, shipping, returns, and value-added services.
• Analyze system logs, IBM i job logs, database records, interface messages, batch jobs, and transaction history to identify faults and restore service.

• Perform root-cause analysis for assigned incidents, document findings, and implement approved corrective and preventive actions in partnership with the WMS Lead.
• Use approved AI and automation capabilities to improve incident troubleshooting, technical analysis, documentation, testing, and operational support while adhering to enterprise security and responsible AI standards.
• Work with L1/L2 support, business teams, integration teams, infrastructure teams, vendors, and software providers to resolve assigned incidents and service requests.
• Participate in the on-call support rotation and provide escalation support during critical operational events, peak periods, planned changes, and major deployments.
• Configure, test, document, and implement approved Manhattan WMi (IBMi Platform) enhancements and operational process changes.
• Support requirement clarification and provide technical input, effort estimates, constraints, and impact findings to the WMS Lead and solution owners.
• Execute impact assessments for assigned changes and raise risks, dependencies, or design concerns for Lead review and decision.
• Support warehouse initiatives, customer or process onboarding, automation changes, and omnichannel capabilities
through configuration, testing, deployment, and hypercare activities.
• Maintain WMS configuration records, technical documentation, process flows, support runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
• Monitor and support integrations between WMS, SAP, order management, transportation systems, automation platforms, carrier solutions, and reporting services.
• Investigate interface failures, inventory synchronization issues, transaction errors, data mismatches, and batch- processing exceptions, escalating design or ownership decisions when needed.
• Perform operational validation and data reconciliation to help protect inventory accuracy and process continuity across connected systems.
• Work with integration and infrastructure specialists on assigned reliability, monitoring, performance, and recovery improvements.
• Support Manhattan SCI (IBM Cognos) reporting capabilities used by warehouse operations.
• Create, modify, validate, and troubleshoot approved operational reports, queries, and data extracts.
• Investigate reporting discrepancies and data-quality issues and document the identified cause and resolution.
• Work with stakeholders and the WMS Lead to clarify reporting needs and translate approved requirements into reliable reports.
• Participate in process reviews, requirements sessions, technical walkthroughs, and solution design discussions as the WMi subject-matter expert.
• Prepare and execute SIT and UAT support, deployment checklists, production validation, go-live support, hypercare, and stabilization activities.
• Provide technical guidance to L1/L2 support analysts and share knowledge that improves first-contact diagnosis and resolution.
• Create and maintain vendor support cases, provide required diagnostic evidence, track progress, and escalate blockers through the WMS Lead.
• Contribute technical findings and improvement recommendations to incident reviews, problem management, service improvement, and modernization initiatives.

Role Requirements
• Deep hands-on experience supporting Manhattan WMi (IBMi Platform) in a large-scale distribution environment.
• Strong L2/L3 application support expertise, including incident triage, technical diagnosis, production recovery, root- cause analysis, and problem management.
• Working knowledge of IBM i operations relevant to application support, such as job logs, job queues, output queues, scheduled jobs, libraries, files, and batch processing.
• Explore future opportunities to responsibly apply AI and intelligent automation to improve WMS reliability, proactive issue detection, operational efficiency, and warehouse decision-making.
• Strong SQL and database analysis skills for investigating operational issues, validating transactions, and supporting data reconciliation.
• Experience troubleshooting integrations and data synchronization across WMS, SAP, order management, transportation, automation, carrier, and reporting platforms.
• Strong understanding of warehouse processes, including receiving, putaway, inventory management, cycle counting, replenishment, wave planning, picking, packing, shipping, returns, VAS, and omnichannel fulfillment.
• Ability to execute approved technical changes independently while escalating architecture, priority, scope, and risk decisions to the WMS Lead.
• Experience supporting testing, deployment, production validation, hypercare, and operational handover activities.
• Experience working directly with Distribution Center Operations in a high-priority production support environment.
• Clear technical documentation, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.
• Ability to manage multiple assigned priorities across regions and time zones while maintaining reliable delivery and support.
• Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and planned production activities outside standard business hours when required.
• Experience using ServiceNow for incident, problem, change, and service request management within a production support environment.
• Experience using Jira to manage technical work, defects, enhancements, and delivery activities, with Confluence used for technical documentation, runbooks, knowledge articles, and solution documentation.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Supply Chain Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, experience, and training.
• 6+ years of experience supporting Warehouse Management Systems, including 4+ years of hands-on experience with Manhattan WMi (IBMi Platform).
• Strong working knowledge of the IBM i (IBMi/AS400) platform, including RPG/RPGLE, CL, DB2 for i (SQL), batch processing, job logs, libraries, queues, and application-level troubleshooting in a production support environment.
• Proven experience providing advanced L2/L3 production support for business-critical warehouse or supply chain applications.
• Hands-on experience with Manhattan WMi (IBMi Platform) configuration, IBM i application support, SQL and database troubleshooting, integrations, and batch processing.
• Ability to Read
• Experience with Manhattan SCI (IBM Cognos) report development and support preferred.
• Experience supporting SAP integrations and inventory, order, or fulfillment flows preferred.
• Experience supporting multi-site or global supply chain and logistics operations preferred.
• Exposure to warehouse automation, robotics, sortation, conveyor, WCS, transportation, order management, or carrier platforms preferred.
• Retail, footwear, apparel, consumer products, or omnichannel distribution experience preferred.
• Exposure to Manhattan SCALE, Manhattan Active WM, Databricks, or modern reporting and integration platforms is a plus.
• Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, Jira, and Confluence in an enterprise application support or engineering environment.
• Experience using AI tools and intelligent automation to automate support workflows, improve self-service capabilities, accelerate troubleshooting, and reduce operational dependency on technology support teams is a plus.
