title: Senior Software Engineer - Frontend
description:
Overview

Microsoft Advertising is a $15B+ business that helps advertisers connect with customers across search, display, and emerging AI-powered channels. We work closely with leading global brands to improve their return on investment, incubate new initiatives, and shape the future of digital advertising.

The Microsoft Advertising Web UI team builds modern, scalable, accessible, and AI-powered frontend experiences that enable advertisers to create, manage, analyze, and optimize campaigns. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will collaborate with engineers, product managers, designers, and partner teams to deliver intuitive, reliable, and high-performance web experiences using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and other modern frontend technologies.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We work with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Product Development, Ownership, and Code Review

- Independently design, code, test, and deliver extensible, maintainable, secure, accessible, and performant Web UI solutions using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and modern frontend technologies.
- Take end-to-end ownership of product features, proactively identifying blockers and risks, communicating timeline impacts, and driving strategies to unblock delivery.
- Apply a customer-obsessed, product-engineering mindset when making design, quality, performance, and delivery trade-offs.
- Deliver timely, high-quality code reviews that improve coding patterns, security, compliance, test coverage, and engineering best practices.
- Use automated analysis, telemetry, and engineering metrics to continuously improve code quality and product stability.

AI-Native Development

- Apply an AI-first mindset and use AI tools responsibly across requirements, design, development, testing, debugging, and documentation.
- Take responsibility for the quality, security, and correctness of AI-generated artifacts while helping teammates adopt effective AI-assisted engineering practices.
- Experiment with emerging AI capabilities and use engineering-health measures such as Accelerate, SPACE, and ESSP to improve team processes and productivity.

Design and Architecture

- Lead the architecture and technical design of complex Web UI features, evaluating design alternatives and documenting their strengths and trade-offs.
- Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, resiliency, accessibility, security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
- Identify and manage upstream and downstream dependencies across services and partner teams.
- Develop testable architectures and comprehensive strategies covering unit, integration, end-to-end, accessibility, security, and regression testing.
- Build reusable UI components, frontend frameworks, and engineering patterns that improve consistency and developer productivity.

Engineering Excellence

- Drive engineering excellence by applying secure design principles, frontend best practices, automation, and safe deployment processes.
- Champion improvements to Web UI performance, accessibility, reliability, maintainability, and developer experience.
- Introduce new initiatives, tools, and engineering practices that make development and validation faster and more effective.
- Ensure privacy, security, safety, accessibility, and compliance requirements are incorporated throughout the development lifecycle.
- Mentor and coach engineers through technical guidance, code-review feedback, and leading by example with a strong growth mindset.

Delivery and Reliability

- Collaborate with product managers, designers, researchers, and engineering partners to drive project plans, release plans, estimation, and delivery.
- Use experimentation, feature flags, flighting, success metrics, and guardrail metrics to evaluate product changes and minimize customer impact.
- Deploy changes safely using established frameworks, staged rollouts, monitoring, and rollback plans.
- Integrate privacy-aware logging, instrumentation, and telemetry into dashboards and alerts to monitor performance, reliability, availability, and usage.
- Act as a designated responsible individual during live-site incidents, respond within SLA, communicate status, and drive mitigation.
- Reduce incident volume by improving troubleshooting guides, automated tests, monitoring, operational tools, and incident postmortems.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.
- Experience developing production web applications using JavaScript or TypeScript and a modern frontend framework.
- Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, software design, testing, and version control.
- Experience designing, debugging, and maintaining reliable and maintainable software.
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, designers, and cross-functional partners.
- AI-native development orientation and willingness to use AI tools responsibly throughout the software development lifecycle.
- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership of complex or ambiguous technical problems.
- Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical decisions and collaborate across teams and time zones.
- Growth mindset, openness to feedback, and commitment to continuous learning.
- Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security-screening requirements. This includes passing the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.

Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualification

- Master’s Degree in Computer Science or a related technical field and 6+ years of technical engineering experience; OR Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related technical field and 8+ years of technical engineering experience; OR equivalent experience.
- Strong experience with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, state-management technologies, and modern frontend build and testing frameworks.
- Experience architecting large-scale, modular web applications and reusable component libraries.
- Knowledge of frontend performance optimization, browser behavior, responsive design, telemetry, and experimentation.
- Experience implementing accessible experiences using WCAG and inclusive-design standards.
- Experience with Azure, distributed services, REST APIs, or GraphQL integrations.
- Experience with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, feature flighting, and safe deployment practices.
- Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across UI, API, and data layers.

#W+D

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Staff Software Engineer (Hybrid, Bangalore)
description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

About Apollo

Apollo is the AI-powered go-to-market platform that helps revenue teams find, engage, and convert their best customers. We combine a database of more than 210 million contacts and 35 million companies with an agentic end-to-end GTM platform, and more than 500,000 companies rely on us to run their go-to-market motion. We are profitable, growing fast, and rebuilding the product around AI and agents.

Your role and mission

You will set technical direction at the level of the whole engineering organization. You will own the hardest, most ambiguous, and highest-stakes technical bets, the ones that shape the product for years, and you will be a force multiplier across many teams. Your judgment will be a reference point for how we build, and your impact will be felt org-wide rather than on any single team.

What You Will Do

- Own the technical direction of Apollo's most critical and most ambiguous problems, across team and organizational boundaries
- Make the architectural bets that shape the product and platform over multiple years, and be accountable for how they play out
- Set the technical strategy for the rebuild around AI and agents, and turn it into direction teams can execute
- Raise the engineering bar across the whole organization through the standards, patterns, and decisions you drive
- Multiply the output of engineers and teams far beyond your own code, through design, review, and mentorship of our most senior engineers
- Partner with engineering and product leadership as a peer on where the technology needs to go. 

How we work: AI-native by default

You set the standard for what AI-native engineering looks like at the highest level. You use agents to move faster on the hardest design, investigation, and implementation work, you define the practices other engineers adopt, and you find the step-change bets where AI reshapes how we build the product, not just how fast we ship.

What We Are Looking For

- A track record of setting technical direction that shaped a product or platform across an entire engineering organization
- Depth across distributed systems and architecture, and command of the reliability, scale, and cost tradeoffs behind company-defining decisions
- The judgment to make the hardest calls under ambiguity, and the influence to align many teams behind them
- A record of multiplying the most senior engineers around you. Genuine, current fluency with AI-assisted development, and a clear point of view on where AI takes engineering next

Our tech stack

React on the front end; Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Python, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch on the backend; Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform in infrastructure; GCP for cloud.

What You Will Love About Apollo

You will own the technical bets that define the company, work as a peer to engineering and product leadership, and have the scope and AI tooling to shape how a fast-moving organization builds.

We are AI Native

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

Learn more here!

Our Story

About The Role

We are building a holistic AdTech platform that delivers premium value to both advertisers and publishers, and the backend is where that entire ecosystem actually runs - the ad marketplace, campaign creation, ad-serving decisioning, analytics collection, attribution, and ROAS measurement.

Concretely, that means large-scale architecture: the ad-serving systems that make real-time decisioning calls at volume, the scalable data platforms that ingest and process billions of events a day, the analytics platforms that turn that data into attribution and ROAS numbers advertisers and publishers trust, and the autonomous AI agents we're building to automate campaign optimization and decisioning across the platform.

We are looking for a Backend Engineer who wants to be genuinely involved in building these areas out - not just implementing tickets, but understanding the product and system tradeoffs behind them - and who'll grow into owning larger pieces of the platform over time.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain the backend systems and APIs behind our ad marketplace, campaign management, and analytics/attribution pipelines.
- Contribute to the scalable data platforms and ad-serving systems that process and act on data at volume.
- Help build and maintain the backend infrastructure behind our autonomous AI agents.
- Collaborate with product, other backend engineers, and DevOps to ship end-to-end features.
- Model and manage data using SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis), including caching where useful.
- Implement authentication, authorization, and data security practices under senior engineers' guidance.
- Write clean, well-documented, well-tested code.
- Deploy, monitor, and scale services on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
- Use Docker (and optionally Kubernetes) for containerization of backend services.
- Contribute to and help maintain CI/CD pipelines.
- Monitor and debug production issues using observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
- Participate actively in code reviews and contribute to team development standards.
- Work within event-driven or microservices architectures, using tools like GraphQL, WebSockets, or message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) where they fit the problem.

Requirements

- 2–4 years of professional backend engineering experience.
- Deep experience with a backend language and its ecosystem (e.g., Node.js/Express, Python, Java, Go); comfortable owning services end-to-end in production.
- Strong understanding of RESTful API design and asynchronous programming.
- Solid experience with relational and NoSQL databases, including basic data modeling.
- Familiarity with Docker, Git, and modern CI/CD workflows.
- Hands-on experience deploying to cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
- Working knowledge of backend security best practices.
- Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
- Comfortable in a fast-paced, agile environment with evolving priorities.
- Exposure to monitoring, logging, or performance profiling in production is a plus.

- Experience designing, developing, testing, and supporting automation solutions for production operations, incident management, observability, or reliability engineering use cases.

- Hands-on experience with messaging and data platforms – Kafka plus SQL/NoSQL stores (e.g., Cosmos DB, Cassandra, MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle); ability to reason about scale, schema evolution and data access patterns.
- Cloud-native engineering: Kubernetes, CI/CD, automated testing and observability, with strong ownership of production readiness and reliability.
- Excellent production troubleshooting skills: logs, metrics, traces, thread dumps/profiling, incident mitigation and root-cause analysis.

- Excellent organisation, communication and interpersonal skills.

- Redis/Memcached, Cassandra/Cosmos DB and high-scale data-modeling experience.
- Multi-region/multi-tenant architecture, disaster recovery, resilience/chaos testing and SRE practices.

description:

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. A Senior SDE at Razorpay is well-grounded - smart, quality-focused, product-thinking, and business-conscious. Not a mere coder. You bring strong technical context and the experience to build software that matters at scale. Engineering at Razorpay creates significant impact across the payments ecosystem. You are expected to influence the culture of the company - bring conviction, challenge the status quo, set the bar, and help the team grow. We are looking for engineers who are current - not just technically strong, but actively working in AI-augmented workflows. At Razorpay, AI is not a feature we are building toward - it is part of how we build today.

What You Will Build

- Ability to understand end-user requirements, formulate use cases, and arrive at effective solutions
- Good understanding of REST APIs and the web in general
- Ability to build a feature from scratch and drive it to completion independently
- Willingness to learn new technology - whatever lets you deliver the best product

AI Fluency We Expect
